remove.description: The `message` field is no longer required if the document has an `event.original` field.

Set values in aws.cloudtrail.request_parameters, aws.cloudtrail.response_elements, and aws.cloudtrail.additional_eventdata. If _conf.keep_flattened_duplicates is true, also copy into aws.cloudtrail.flattened. Since aws.cloudtrail.flattened is optionally present, is MUST NEVER be used as an RHS in any processor. Assignments of json.requestParameters, json.responseElements, json.additionalEventData and json.serviceEventDetails to the corresponding flattened fields are shallow, so sub-fields of these field MUST NEVER be renamed or otherwise mutated, that is, they MUST NEVER be an LHS in any processor.
